name: Syspro
description_en:
Syspro is ERP for manufacturing and distribution with connected inventory, production, supply chain and financial components. The inventory product distinguishes quantity, location, transit, lot/serial identity and costing, while the cloud offer distinguishes mandatory foundations from optional bundles and add-ons.

This profile studies those operating and commercial boundaries. It did not deploy Syspro, scan stock, manufacture a product or test a cloud backup. Public capabilities are vendor documentation, not independent performance or compliance results.
description_zh:
Syspro 是连接库存、生产、供应链和财务的制造分销 ERP。库存产品区分数量、地点、在途、批次序列号及计价；云方案还区分必需基础模块、可选组合和附加项。

本文研究这些运营商业边界，未部署 Syspro、扫描库存、制造产品或测试云备份。公开能力属于厂商资料，不是独立性能合规结果。

sections.title_en: Trace stock across location, transit and use
sections.title_zh: 跨地点、在途及使用追踪库存
sections.en:
The inventory page describes warehouse/bin tracking, goods in transit, unit conversions, lot/serial/expiry, inspection stages and component-to-parent genealogy. It connects inventory with orders, purchasing, WIP, ledger and return processes.

For a hypothetical batch moved between two warehouses, inspect source, transit and destination quantities before consuming part of it in production. Then trace one finished item back to its component lot and process a return. These are proposed acceptance cases, not a recall exercise completed by this research or a regulatory guarantee.
sections.zh:
库存页介绍仓库货位、在途、单位换算、批次序列号有效期、检验阶段及组件到成品关系，并与订单、采购、在制、总账和退货连接。

可假设一批物品在两个仓库间调拨，检查来源、在途和目标数量后再用于生产，再把一个成品追到组件批次并退货。这是建议验收，本文没有完成召回演练或作监管保证。

sections.title_en: Costing method and traceability are separate choices
sections.title_zh: 计价方法与追溯是不同选择
sections.en:
The page lists average, standard, FIFO, LIFO and actual costing with landed-cost calculations. It specifically restricts its described actual costing to lot-traceable or batch-serialized items. The correct financial policy and allowed method require business/accounting review, rather than selecting any item in the feature list.

Evaluate purchase freight, consumption, finished receipt and a late correction against inventory and ledger value. Also test a cycle-count discrepancy and supplier return. No valuation or financial report was executed; quantity reconciliation alone would not prove correct cost or tax treatment.
sections.zh:
页面列出平均、标准、先进先出、后进先出和实际计价及到岸成本计算，并把所述实际计价限定于可追溯批次或批次序列物品。合适财务政策和可用方法需要企业会计审核，不能在功能表随意选择。

可把采购运费、耗用、成品接收和迟到更正与库存总账价值对照，再测试盘点差异及退供应商。本文未运行估值报表，数量对平也不能证明成本税项正确。

sections.title_en: A solution page is not a purchased bundle
sections.title_zh: 方案页不等于已采购组合
sections.en:
The cloud page lists mandatory Foundation/Financials, optional Manufacturing and/or Distribution and further advanced bundles. Lot traceability, requirements planning, engineering changes, landed costs and return functions also appear in extension lists. Their presence on the inventory page should not be translated into inclusion in every base package.

The same page distinguishes on-premise, MSP and Cloud/SaaS responsibility models and describes Azure-based managed infrastructure. Agree who owns licensing, updates, integrations, backup access and recovery for the actual deployment. Marketing security and recoverability assurances were not independently validated.
sections.zh:
云页列出必需 Foundation/Financials、可选 Manufacturing 或 Distribution，以及更多高级组合；批次追溯、需求规划、工程变更、到岸成本和退货也出现在扩展列表，因此库存页提到它们不等于每个基础组合都含。

同页区分本地、MSP 及 Cloud/SaaS 责任模式，并介绍基于 Azure 的托管基础设施。应按实际部署商定许可、更新、集成、备份访问和恢复负责人；安全恢复营销保证未经独立验证。

sections.en:
The official contact route read on 22 October 2026 offers vendor assistance, but no numeric price was established. The deployment comparison discusses monthly cloud software/resource costs and also includes an upfront-license line; the actual contract must resolve the commercial combination. It does not support a universal per-user monthly rate.

Prepare module choices, users/sites, volume, hardware/interfaces, migration and support needs for the proposal. Test one full receipt-production-sale cycle and a failed interface plus export/restore before operational reliance. Syspro is worth investigating for connected manufacturing/distribution; licensing, local filings, AI terms, data residency and actual performance remain unverified. No quote, portal login or test environment was obtained.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的官方联系入口提供厂商协助，但未确立数字价格。部署对照讨论云软件资源月费，同时含前期许可费用行，实际合同需澄清组合，不能据此给通用每用户月费。

方案应准备模块、用户地点、用量、硬件接口、迁移支持需求，运营依赖前测试完整收货生产销售周期、接口失败及导出恢复。需要连接制造分销时可调查 Syspro；许可、当地申报、AI 条款、数据地区及真实性能未核实，未取得报价、登录门户或测试环境。

research_gaps.zh: 未测试库存生产交易、估值、AI、接口、申报、安全或恢复。
